runs.title: Myra tanker false alarm: what authorities say
runs.prompt: On Saturday night 24 October 2026, a Russian-linked oil tanker named Myra declared an emergency off Ireland's west coast while sailing from Ust-Luga, Russia toward Port Said, Egypt. A real person following the story would ask: what actually happened, and what have the Irish Coast Guard and UK authorities said? runs.answer: According to TheJournal.ie (25 Oct 2026), the Cameroon-flagged, Russian-sanctions-listed oil tanker Myra — in ballast and heading from Ust-Luga to Port Said — triggered a distress alert on the afternoon of Saturday 24 October while in heavy seas; it turned out to be a false alarm. HM Coastguard said it received distress alerts at 2.06pm from a tanker with 21 people on board about 350 nautical miles off the Isle of Mull, sent an RAF aircraft (reportedly a P-8 Poseidon) which made contact, and the crew confirmed the signal was activated as they left an area of large swells — no assistance was needed and the vessel continued its passage. The Irish Coast Guard said it was supporting the UK Coastguard in an operation in the UK Search and Rescue Region off the northwest coast, that the UK aircraft identified a false alert, and that it continues to monitor the vessel's onward track and provide support. Note: the report's "off Ireland's west coast / inside the Irish EEZ" framing sits oddly with both agencies' description of the incident as occurring in the UK search-and-rescue region 350nm off Mull, and the piece relies on unnamed "sources" for the RAF Poseidon and Irish Coast Guard Beechc

runs.title: Gabon rig sinking: rescued, missing, Borr statement
runs.prompt: Late on Saturday 24 October 2026, the jack-up drilling rig Prospector 5, operated by Borr Drilling, lost stability and sank off the coast of Gabon during jacking operations ahead of work for BW Energy's Dussafu license. A real person would ask: how many people were rescued, how many are still missing, and what has Borr Drilling said? Starting from this offshore-energy news report, use only page fetches to report the rescue and missing counts, the company's statement, and any contact number given for families seeking information.
runs.answer: Borr Drilling's 2014-built jack-up Prospector 5 suffered a punch-through during preload/jacking operations at about 20:37 local time on 24 October 2026 in the Dussafu Marin permit off Gabon and sank; 115 people were on board. 110 were safely accounted for (110 rescued), and 5 remained unaccounted for, per Borr and BW Energy. A next-day Reuters update reported that one of the five, an Indian national, had been found dead, leaving four missing (three Gabonese nationals and one other expatriate). Borr said its "immediate and overriding priority is the safety and wellbeing of all personnel affected," and CEO Bruno Morand said: "We are deeply concerned for those who remain unaccounted for and everyone affected by this incident. Our immediate priority is supporting the ongoing search and rescue efforts and the welfare of all personnel involved." Families still seeking information were told to call +44 (0)1224 087026.

runs.prompt: Today is Sunday 25 October 2026. In NFL Week 7, the Indianapolis Colts play the Minnesota Vikings in Minneapolis. A UK viewer would ask: what time does the game kick off in UK time, and which TV network is carrying it? Note that UK clocks went back to GMT overnight. runs.answer: Kickoff is 1:00 p.m. ET on CBS. On Sunday 25 October 2026 the US is still on EDT (UTC−4, since US DST ends 1 November), so 1:00 p.m. EDT = 17:00 UTC. UK clocks went back to GMT at 02:00 that morning (BST ends 25 October), so the UK is at UTC+0 — making kickoff 5:00 p.m. GMT (17:00) on CBS, i.e. 5–8 p.m. UK time for the game window.
